lineage.description: IPC classification data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule across Mali in 2017. Geographic polygons represent areas classified into IPC phases (1-5) indicating acute food insecurity severity. Data provided in multiple snapshots (February, June, October 2017) with scenario projections.
